patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.14 (600 dpi) prints 'X = U[:,:r]V[:r,:]' in the Lemma 1 proof: U's numpy-style row slice carries two colons '[:, :r]' while V's '[:r,:]' is as transcribed; the OCR dropped U's second colon. The patch restores the printed slice without changing any other character.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.16 (300 dpi) prints the Figure 6 listing with the for-loop body (printed lines 20-28: three comments and the six statements ending 'factors.append( 1/ (p**2).sum()**0.5)') indented one level under 'for _ in range(iter_times):', and 'return np.mean(factors)' (line 29) dedented back to function-body level.
